description: Minecraft Mod which aims to add more bosses, to make those bosses more difficult to find/kill, and get more reward from killing them. This mod is currently in Beta, and I will likely continue work on it within a year or so. For now, you can check it out on CurseForge. https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/morebosses
